verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL docs state that users can inspect a query's execution plan to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities. They also say the product gives automatic insights and recommendations when queries run inefficiently, which covers the core of diagnosing why a query is slow. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of query profile contents (operator-level metrics, time and spill breakdowns), explicit per-query cost or expense attribution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
